title: Intended Treatment
description: Each treatment entry must include both a valid disposalOrRecoveryCode and a weight. Used as intendedTreatments (Creation, mandatory, min 1) — both fields always required, unlike Receipt's actualTreatment (actual-treatment.schema.json) where disposalOrRecoveryCode is optional and weight is conditional on it.

disposalOrRecoveryCode.description: Must be a valid code from GET /reference-data/disposal-or-recovery-codes.
